## TL;DR: upgrade testing, weekend of 10–12 October 2026 **What was tested.** Real upgrades from main (e683dd9ea5) to the branch, on built code, with traffic flowing throughout. Every check runs on each trial: nothing deleted, every step done, queue drains, live calls answered, logs clean, browser walk, Ops state. Results are in the #8560 comments. **Cloud: we are sure of (✅ on the final build).** - Empty install, small cloud, medium cloud (10 orgs), data retention: data reads back, nothing deleted, retention unchanged. - Sign-in: old Auth0 deployment sign-in, old per-org SSO (carried over), new per-org OIDC and SAML, passwords. Organisation and role kept. - Private ClickHouse and S3 per org: no data ever in the wrong place. Each ClickHouse upgrades on its own. A down one holds only its org and catches up. A missing route answers 503, never shared data. - Replicated ClickHouse (2 replicas behind a balancer): first attempt passes, replicas identical. - Awkward data (held org, plaintext keys, Postgres datasets, untagged prompts) and operator damage (failed migration row, hand-built index): refused by name, resumes by itself after the fix. - Drills: crash mid-step (nothing lost, resumes from checkpoint), lock held, API before worker, failed first install, old worker lingering, two upgraders racing. **Cloud at scale (🟡).** 2,007 orgs and 200k users: live telemetry is never held up (0 lost), 0 errors, queue bounded (peak 39k, was 585k), nothing deleted. Background steps take longer than 45 minutes to finish. One Redis bookkeeping growth during a pass is being fixed. **Real bugs found and fixed this weekend (all in #8580).** - A worker crash lost the job it held. Now it re-runs. - The migration pass stalled for 60 minutes after a crash. Leases now renew. - Background work flooded the queue at scale. Now paced by its own work, including inside a big org. - Redis froze for 70 s from one script. Now sliced. - Replicated ClickHouse: a stale read could rerun a migration. Now uses a quorum. - A hand-built index was silently accepted. Now refused by name. - Busy or down ClickHouse answered 500. Now 503 with a code. - Old workers burned job attempts in a rolling deploy. Now handed back. - The boot screen left a blank page for a moment. Fixed. - Auth0 password path removed after the hash import. **Parked for the self-hosted release.** Below-floor refusal (3.19.4 → T10 ❌) and a 15 s read error from 3.20.1 (T11 ❌). ## Progress summary **1,016 rows: 989 pass, 12 have problems, 0 being walked, 15 not started.** Counted 2026-10-12 08:17 UTC by `ledger-count.py` from the body and 2677 comments; a later result, claim or release comment overrides the body. | | rows | ✅ | 🟡 | ❌ | ⚠️ | ⏳ | ⬜ | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Upgrade | 48 | 28 | 2 | 3 | | | 15 | | Custom flows | 12 | 11 | 1 | | | | | | Product flows | 30 | 29 | | | 1 | | | | Beyond the UI | 9 | 9 | | | | | | | Areas | 917 | 912 | 2 | | 3 | | | | **Total** | 1,016 | 989 | 5 | 3 | 4 | | 15 |
